name: sign-up
title: Sign up
description: Account creation: name, email, password with requirements, terms consent, submit; optional providers.

frame.summary: Same column as sign-in, so switching between the two does not move anything.

regions.name: header
regions.purpose: Heading, "Already have an account? Sign in".

components.name: field
components.for: Password requirements as the field's description, validation as its message.

components.name: list
components.for: Password requirement checklist inside the field description.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Requirements as one sentence in TextField's description.
Providers below the form, no separator.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the form heading; everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

onSubmit.summary: Receives the values; reject with field errors or a form error.
onSubmit.type: (values: { name: string; email: string; password: string; marketing: boolean }) => Promise<void>

passwordRules.summary: Requirements shown under the password field and checked as the reader types.
passwordRules.type: Array<{ label: string; test: (value: string) => boolean }>

termsHref.summary: Terms of service link inside the consent label.

behavior.summary: Validate on blur and on submit, never on every keystroke except the password checklist, which updates silently and is announced only on blur.

decisions.decision: Errors on submit move focus to the first invalid field
decisions.why: WCAG 3.3.1; the field's message is already tied to it by Field's aria-describedby.

decisions.decision: Consent is a required Checkbox, never pre-checked
decisions.why: Pre-checked consent is not consent in most jurisdictions.

decisions.decision: The checklist does not use a live region
decisions.why: Announcing every rule flip while typing is noise; the summary is read on blur as the field's message.
Splitting three fields over steps adds navigation without reducing effort; onboarding-steps is for what happens after the account exists.

obligations: Required fields marked with Field's `required`, not only an asterisk.

steps.change: Column fills the viewport less the gutter.

native.reason: App block: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: A form screen; password requirements under the field; consent row with a link to an in-app web view of the terms.
